scope: Owner-approved isolated exact-Gram diagnostic on three flagged designs; not integration, confirmation or paper promotion.

exact_method: Capture the actual independent-unit design through coefficient predictions, in the fitter's row order. Independently form its orthogonal projector by dense SVD in Python and calculate K=Z'((I-P) elementwise squared)Z. Check rank, orthogonality, symmetry, idempotence, and predictions against captured live-solver Gaussian projections. Load only K into the isolated native copy, checking exact dimensions and basis values before substitution. Keep computing the original 2048 probes so RNG and public receipts remain unchanged; label their Gram unused after substitution.
bounds: At most 1500 independent units and 100 coefficient columns in each diagnostic capture. Dense matrices are research-only, never added to production. No Veneto exact computation or new datasets.
prerequisites: One unchanged 2048 capture per selected design, independent analytical/dense oracle and malformed-input tests, one exact-Gram saved draw per cell and deliberate CLI/input failures. Freeze source, exact matrices, original inputs, task inventory, executables and reporting before the 600-call main replay.
report: Account for all four targets on every attempted replication, retaining original eligibility and V1 screens as diagnostic comparisons. Report Gram error, conditioning, floor shares, coverage, SD/RMS-SE, current/512/2048/exact arms and point invariance. This selected failure subset cannot qualify the estimator even if its screens pass.
stop: Complete this bounded comparison and discuss the numerical versus downstream implications. No automatic model change, further budget increase, new outcome draws, integration or release.
